text: The lack of maturity of blockchain technology has slowed its integration into the corporate world, and the absence of a legal framework leaves the whole industry operating in a grey area of the law, which introduces uncertainty and a new level of volatility.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Blockchain Technology and Race in Corporate America (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3071378

isBasedOn.name: Blockchain Technology and Race in Corporate America

abstract: The lack of maturity has slowed the progression of integration into the corporate world. There is still a lack of legal framework for the industry to work with, which causes uncertainty. Without knowing which laws apply, the whole industry is operating in a grey area of the law.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: before Congress adopts a policy on the treatment of blockchain services
